title: Editor crashes while moving docks to margins over scene tree outline
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.8.dev4.mono.official [b56a91878]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev4.mono - Windows 10 (build 17134) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (2560x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.3141) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700 CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads) - 23.92 GiB memory - WASAPI (96000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Moving docks by dragging it into margins can crash Godot.

~~It's a bit hard to reproduce reliably.~~ But I had this happen a few times already.
~~I can make it happen by playing around with the docks for a few minutes.~~

It seems the crash happens when you **drag a dock** to a margin position and the **mouse is above a scene tree parent line/link**.
I can reliably reproduce this now.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/96ca3672-a0ec-4c38-80d9-feb5e906a1e9

You don't even need to drop. Just passing the mouse while dragging the dock is enough for the crash to happen

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d608e0dd-c84c-4edb-8c2b-795bb464258d

----

### Steps to reproduce

Steps:

1. Have the outline tree filled in some nested nodes. 
2. Drag a dock and mouse over the tree lines and colapse icons until the crash happen

**Results:** Editor Crashes
Expected: Don't crash
